title: Orbis · Agent 状态与架构全景

baseline.scope: D:/orbis 当前工作树，包含审计开始时的 34 项 git status 变更记录；源码静态审计，不代表已安装 Host / App 的运行版本。

states.name: 身份与运行元数据
states.owner: 后端定义 Session / runtime；Host 定义电脑与路由身份
states.store: 各后端 metadata；Host 按需拼目录
states.verdict: 共同 Metadata 已有，尚无完整 Host Agent 实例。RuntimeMetadata 没有 agentKind，App 仍从 runtimeId 推断。
states.target: AgentState.identity：显式 hostId / agentKind / runtimeId / sessionId，保留原生引用

states.name: 后端可用性与桌面接入
fields: CodexDesktop.state: unsupported | notInstalled | closed | attached | error
states.owner: Host 聚合 readiness 与桌面生命周期
states.verdict: 符合 Host 管理、App 跟随。3 个产品、4 个 kind：pi / codex / codexDesktop / dsh；CONTEXT 三值说明已落后于源码。
states.target: HostState.backends；AgentState.availability 引用后端事实

states.name: 会话目录与归档
states.owner: 原生后端拥有目录与归档；Host 聚合
states.store: 原生文件 / RPC；Host catalogCache；App SessionCatalog
states.verdict: 目录已统一。Host 跳过失败后端而结果缺少每后端完整性标记；App 仍有 DSH 专属缺席规则。
states.target: HostState.catalog 逐后端 completeness / revision；条目引用 AgentState

states.name: 聊天历史与 canonical Entries
states.owner: 原生历史权威；后端确定性投影
states.store: Pi SessionManager / Codex thread 与 rollout / DSH follow；App SQLite
states.sync: session.sync → session.snapshot；patch 带新提交 Entries
states.verdict: 复制契约与事务入库已统一；Entry.data 仍是开放形状，App 解释 PiMessageProjection / compaction。保留原生权威本身合理。
states.target: AgentState.history 分页引用 + 适配层统一 displayEntries；Host 不必存全量历史数据库

states.name: 会话分支与当前 head
states.owner: 后端确认 head；App 缓存 parent 链
states.verdict: head 与完整性契约已明确。Pi tree、Codex revert、DSH fork 语义不同，适配器需提供对应能力。
states.target: AgentState.history.head；branch 操作语义由 adapter 持有

states.name: 实时消息与流式正文
states.owner: 源端保存可恢复正文；App 镜像
states.store: Pi source 在扩展；Codex liveMessages / DSH source 在 Host 的适配器
states.verdict: 已实现可恢复模型，非仅 delta。通用 Host 未保存统一 live 库存；App sourceEpoch 建立前仍可处理旧生命周期事件。
states.target: AgentState.live.messages；Host 有限当前投影；适配器确认 canonical 映射

states.name: 回合身份与计时
states.owner: 后端确认边界；App 只计算展示 elapsed
states.store: source.live.turn + timing store；SQLite 已提交 timing
states.verdict: 结构统一，分散在 source、timing store 与 App conversation。尚未汇入 Host 聚合。
states.target: AgentState.execution.turn + 历史 timing 引用

states.name: 工具调用与执行结果
states.owner: 原生执行器权威；适配器归一
states.store: source.live.tools / canonical 工具结果；App tools
states.verdict: 公共结构与库存恢复已有，detail 仍 unknown；Host 不聚合工具库存，历史显示仍依赖客户端投影。
states.target: AgentState.live.tools：input / output / phase / turnId / messageId

states.name: 运行与等待状态
states.owner: 后端从原生事实投影
states.store: Pi runtime-status / Codex ThreadState / DSH WebSession
states.verdict: 已有三态；DSH metadata 仅 running/idle，审批库存未归一到等待态。socket 在线不能当作可执行。
states.target: AgentState.execution.phase / waitingReason / verification

states.name: 重试与上下文压缩
fields: 无统一 retry / compacting 字段
states.owner: 原生后端确认恢复
states.sync: 部分通知发布；部分仅影响 running 与队列释放
states.verdict: 无跨后端统一执行子状态。Codex 重试已保留归属/恢复语义，不能宣称其他后端已具备同一库存。
states.target: AgentState.execution.retry / compaction 显式 availability 与 phase

states.name: 交互请求与审批
states.owner: 后端 broker / native approval
states.store: 后端完整库存；Host interactionIds；App PendingInteraction
states.verdict: 请求/快照已统一；Host 只存 ID 而非完整交互投影。手机 submitted 是本地事实，不能混为远端完成。
states.target: AgentState.interactions + DeviceView submit receipts

states.name: 消息队列与投递状态
fields: state: accepted | delivered | cancelled | rejected | not_cancelable
states.owner: 后端执行队列；Bridge 幂等回执
states.store: Pi queuedSends / Bridge shadow；Codex queue；DSH native queue + local Map
states.verdict: 回执 schema 已统一，真队列分后端；无 Host 统一版本化库存。手机不能成为队列执行器。
states.target: AgentState.delivery.queue 为权威投影，native 保持执行权

states.name: 命令关联与执行回执
fields: status: pending | success | failure | cancelled | not_cancelable | already_delivered | message_id_conflict
states.owner: Host 管设备归属；后端确认结果
states.store: Host commandOwners 有界账本；后端幂等；App pending/results
states.verdict: 归属统一，结果仍独立请求链路，缺聚合操作库存/恢复摘要；不同设备回执不能共享泄漏。
states.target: HostState.operations + DeviceView.commandReceipts

states.name: 权限摘要与可编辑设置
fields: raw sandbox / approvalPolicy / reviewer / networkAccess / roots / profile / problem
states.owner: 后端校验原生语义与确认；Host 路由
states.verdict: 子契约符合方向：App 仅渲染 opaque options 和文案。Pi 编辑不支持须明确不可用；仍待纳入聚合模型。
states.target: AgentState.permissions；单次审批与会话设置分作用域

states.name: 当前模型、思考级别与选项
states.owner: 原生会话选择；adapter 生成选项
states.verdict: 当前模型统一；可选模型仍挂 commands。Host 当前配置 provider、会话 model.provider、历史 modelProvider 含义不同。
states.target: AgentState.model.selection / options / effectiveProviderRef

states.name: 上下文占用与 token 状态
states.owner: 原生上下文与 adapter
states.verdict: Codex 使用 last 输入非累计 total；Pi tokens 可未知。DSH 声明/输出 usage，但当前模块未找到赋值，不能算接入完成。
states.target: AgentState.context：availability / checkedAt / source；区分上下文和账单用量

states.name: 命令能力与资源菜单
fields: source: builtin | extension | prompt | skill | mcp
states.owner: backend 发布真实支持子集
states.verdict: 菜单协议统一。后端能力差异合理，不应伪造共同功能；Host 缺完整资源库存投影。
states.target: AgentState.capabilities / resources；按支持能力驱动 App

states.name: 通知生产者事实
states.owner: backend 确认条件与恢复
states.store: NotificationSource 当前集合/有界一次结果回执
states.verdict: 来源协议已标准化；通知版本与 session source 独立合理。聚合时应保留各域版本，不靠文字猜恢复。
states.target: AgentState.notifications 引用 Host 投影；producer facts 留 adapter

states.name: Host 通知生命周期与设备展示
states.owner: Host 管 UUID、到期、版本、关闭
states.store: NotificationStore 内存；重建新 epoch；非永久日志
states.verdict: 最接近目标：Host 有完整当前库存，App 校验展示。设备关闭不等于共享恢复，不与聊天水位耦合。
states.target: 复用 NotificationStore 为 AgentState 子模块；DeviceView 过滤

states.name: 供应商手机列表与切换
states.owner: Host ProviderManager
states.verdict: 手机已有列表与切换，绝非桌面独有；只有 requestId 关联，缺领域 revision 与统一模型镜像。
states.target: HostState.providers.publicSummary；AgentState.providerBinding 引用

states.name: 完整供应商配置与认证绑定
states.owner: Host 独占配置与凭据
states.sync: desktop bridge provider.get / draft / save / oauth；手机只见摘要
states.verdict: Host 管理符合职责，但未纳入聚合。密钥是 Host 私有状态，完整 Agent 模型不能理解成将秘密同步给手机。
states.target: HostState.providers.private；公开认证状态/绑定引用

states.name: 供应商用量、健康度与路由
fields: Proxy enabled / queue / retries / timeouts / thresholds
running / baseUrl / activeRequests / totalRequests / successfulRequests / failoverCount / lastProviderId
states.owner: Host UsageCache / Proxy / Circuit
states.store: Host 内存状态 + proxyPreferences；Qt 投影
states.sync: desktop usage/proxyStatus + changed；手机摘要无这些字段
states.verdict: 实现已在 Host，缺公共模型和手机同步。报告描述状态结构，未进行真实供应商健康探测。
states.target: HostState.providers.health / usage / routing；AgentState 引用有效 route

states.name: 诊断日志与实时事件记录
fields: Pi JSONL timestamp / level / event / pid / fields
无共同 log cursor / retention / snapshot
states.owner: Pi 扩展本地诊断；Host emit；Qt 有界记录
states.store: Pi runtime-log 文件；Qt 内存可导出；非远端日志仓库
states.sync: Pi 本地写入；Host JSON-lines → Qt；无 runtime.log 库存协议
states.verdict: 缺统一记录模型/App 补拉。实时聊天已可恢复；诊断日志、通知、canonical 聊天历史为不同域。
states.target: HostState.diagnostics + AgentState.recordsRef；cursor/level/scope/retention/readRange

states.name: 文件产物与会话附件引用
states.owner: Host 文件服务；后端发布引用
states.store: download/upload 服务；message data；App Task stores
states.verdict: 公共 Artifact 元数据已定义；路径附件、工具输出尚不等于 Host Agent artifact inventory。App 仍解释 custom details。
states.target: AgentState.artifacts 引用 FileService；传输在 DeviceView

states.name: 工作区与 Git 分支
states.owner: Host 读 Git HEAD；App 匹配请求
states.verdict: 合理独立。Git 工作区分支与 Session head 含义不同，统一模型可引用。
states.target: HostState.workspaces；AgentState.workspaceRef

states.name: 会话激活与电脑侧操作
states.owner: Host 启动已知 backend
states.store: Spawner / Lifecycle / mutation；App 导航等待
states.verdict: 属于 Host operation；激活回执不证明上线。App 导航等待留本地。
states.target: HostState.operations.activation；AgentState 引用可用性

states.name: 同步任务与背压
fields: stage: queued | processing | sending | delivered | failed
states.owner: Host 关联/去重/预算
states.store: SessionSyncTasks 有界账本 + DeviceLink 队列
states.sync: sync → 定向 snapshot；固定参数重试
states.verdict: 合理独立。操作任务不是 Agent source version，不是 App 逻辑读取；已完成任务不永久留正文。
states.target: HostState.syncOperations / DeviceView.receipts

states.name: Host 身份、配对与设备
states.owner: Host/设备拥有配对身份
states.verdict: 合理独立于 Agent；本报告只列状态结构，未读取或展示用户凭据。
states.target: HostState.identity/devices；App HubState.pairings

states.name: 连接、路径、加密与序号
states.owner: Host 选 active path；双方维护 E2E；Relay 转发密文
states.verdict: 基础设施合理独立。传输 sequence 不等于 Session sourceSeq；ONLINE 不等于 e2eReady。
states.target: HostState.connections + App TransportState

states.name: 安装、桌面与服务生命周期
fields: stage: resolving | downloading | verifying | activating | restarting | restartFailed | done | cancelled | error
states.owner: DesktopRuntime / Qt 管安装与自己服务
states.sync: desktop initialize / detect / start / install progress / status
states.verdict: Host 管理面合理独立。手机没有安装操作，只需要可用性摘要；源码版本不等于运行安装版。
states.target: HostState.management；AgentState.backendRef

states.name: App 缓存、应用水位与恢复
states.owner: 后端权威；App 保证成功应用事实
states.sync: 先事务提交再发布；缺口 sync
states.verdict: 必要接收端状态。SQLite namespace 实际 SHA256(relayUrl,deviceId)；历史缓存不证明完整 live baseline。
states.target: App MirrorState / CacheState

states.name: App 读取操作与重试
fields: phase: QUEUED | LOCAL | REMOTE | WAITING | SUCCEEDED | END_REACHED | FAILED | CANCELLED | SUPERSEDED
states.owner: App 逻辑读取目标/反馈
states.sync: 本地优先 + 固定范围请求 + 结果匹配
states.verdict: 读取状态必要留手机；网络 attempt、source version、spinner 与 Agent running 不能混用。
states.target: App OperationState，保留本地归属和重试

states.name: 上传下载与持久前缀
fields: download taskId / hostId / runtimeId / sessionId / transferId / receivedBytes / status / savedLocation
states.owner: 下载手机磁盘 prefix；上传 Host durable prefix
states.verdict: 联合文件操作合理独立。下载 taskId 未含 hostId 是静态可见隔离风险，尚未实机复现。
states.target: DeviceView.transfers + Host FileOperations；task identity 含 hostId

states.name: App 发件箱与提交反馈
states.owner: App 未确认提交；Host/backend 最终确认
states.verdict: 必要本地。live 为空不能删除未确认提交；关闭通知不能完成审批。
states.target: App OutboxState + DeviceView.receipts

states.name: 多 Host 连接与当前选择
states.owner: App Hub 独立连接与选择
states.sync: 每Host socket/reducer；切换只改展示和命令目标
states.verdict: 合理本地；shutdown 未取消初始化长期协程是静态生命周期风险，尚未运行复现。
states.target: HubState + 每 hostId MirrorState；独立连接 scope

states.name: 草稿、别名、视图与偏好
states.owner: App 本地编辑与显示
states.sync: 本地写入；用户操作另发命令
states.verdict: 合理留 App。统一 Agent 领域状态不要求把视口、草稿或手机 URI 放共享模型。
states.target: App UiState / Preferences / DraftState 引用 host/session

method: 以跨端可观察的领域状态、持久/内存库存及操作生命周期为单位，共36个模块；不是变量数或上游全部私有字段数。覆盖协议、Host、三个产品/四路接入、Android、Qt和相关ADR；上游SDK/模型服务内部状态、Relay运维后台细节、全部Compose临时变量不逐项计数。

25: ## 现有处理为什么不能只放开 running 限制
26: 
27: 以下是设计时通过代码审查确认的处理路径；部分已由下述实施阶段修正，不表示每项均已完成真实链路复现：
28: 
29: | 现有处理 | 可能产生的具体问题 |
30: | --- | --- |
31: | `requestRuntimeRefresh` 在 running 或存在 streaming ID 时返回 | 漏掉结束事件留下的 overlay，会阻止用于修复它的 sync |
32: | sync 主要返回已提交 Entry，live 正文依靠收到的 delta 拼接 | 漏掉正文中段后，没有可读取的完整草稿来补上；只收到后缀也能被显示成普通消息 |
33: | preview/catchup 投影清理 active timing；`turn.finished` 先检查 timing，再处理 mapping | sync、重连、ctl 的 idle 提前到达，都可能使后到的映射被跳过 |
34: | remap 删除目标行；不同 ID 的实时/历史消息按正文等特征猜身份 | canonical 先到时可能被删除；残缺正文不能归并；相同短文本可能误归并 |
35: | 漏结束事件时保留 unfinished message/tool | sync 不携带完整 live 集合，不能证明哪些旧实时对象已经不存在 |
36: | 本地已覆盖 metadata leaf 时，catchup 可以直接结束 | metadata 漏收或 running 中 leaf 尚未发布时，刷新不一定真正查询源端 |
37: | 外层 sequence 按 runtime/channel 分配，包含其他设备的定向响应 | 本机看到数字跳号不一定丢了共享状态；发送时取号也不代表快照采集时点 |
38: | Codex 回放会参考旧内存顺序/parent，外部 revert 尚无完整协调流程 | 相同 Entry ID 可能被重建成不同内容；读取历史与新通知竞争，产生 conflict 或旧尾部复活 |

13: The Host exposes one permission-management contract in Runtime metadata. `permissionManagement` contains a user-facing summary, details, a generic tone (`restricted`, `full`, `unknown`, `problem`), and a collection of select settings. Each setting has an opaque ID, label, current value when known, selectable options with labels and descriptions, and an optional disabled reason. Backends construct this complete projection from native facts. Unknown native facts stay unknown; a preset name alone does not prove its sandbox or network bundle. The mobile client renders these fields without consulting agentKind, native permission values, or the slash menu.
14: 
15: Clients submit `permissions.update { settingId, value }` as an authenticated Runtime command addressed to a Runtime ID. The Host routes it through the existing backend ownership boundary. The backend validates the setting and option against its current supported configuration, rejects unavailable, busy, or concurrent writes, invokes its native API, and publishes refreshed metadata before a successful command result. A native refusal, timeout, or unconfirmed state produces a failure; clients do not optimistically claim effective permissions. The existing command ownership and result path continues to isolate paired devices.
16: 
17: Codex maps select settings to its native thread-settings update and confirmation lifecycle. DSH maps its advertised preset selection to the native permission command and verifies the resulting Session projection. Legacy or unsupported backends omit `permissionManagement`, yielding a read-only unavailable state in clients. No Host-global default silently changes existing Sessions. This first interface controls the addressed Session only; future-session defaults require a separate explicit scope in a future decision.
18: 
19: Approval requests continue through structured interactions and are not automatically answered by this interface. Permission updates are unavailable while the Session is working or has pending approval interactions. The backend remains responsible for enforcing this condition at execution time; client disabling is only feedback.
20: 
21: The existing raw `permissions` metadata remains available for diagnostics and existing backend tests. It is not the presentation or edit contract. Native slash commands may remain for the general command menu, but the permission page never discovers or applies settings through `slash.execute`. This qualifies ADR-0003: permission management is a dedicated typed runtime operational control rather than a second catalog for invoking arbitrary slash commands.
22: 
23: ## Consequences and verification
24: 
25: Adding a permission-capable backend requires a backend adapter and does not require phone-specific mappings. Native semantics, explanatory text, and supported options have one computer-side source. APP and Host must be updated together for the new command; missing management metadata never implies full access.
26: 
27: Tests cover permission projection, option validation, confirmed updates, native failures, busy and concurrent requests, stale native state, and mobile rendering of opaque settings. TypeScript type checks and Android compilation verify the protocol and client changes. Updating a running Host remains a separate explicitly authorized operation.

15: The Windows Host owns the catalog, credentials and native configuration writes. Its Agent page supports installation or update from a fixed npm package per Agent, using a validated version and an isolated installation directory. The selected CLI entry changes only after installation and version validation succeed. The device has no installation operation.
16: 
17: Codex uses an exclusive profile: import the current native configuration, save the outgoing provider-owned settings before switching, then apply the selected `auth.json` and `config.toml`. Shared TOML preferences and MCP remain live resources. Official cards may bind to a Host-owned managed OAuth account; refresh-token rotation and same-identity CLI adoption happen before the native transaction, while live OAuth tokens are never stored in provider cards. Pi uses additive explicit providers: sync exact provider IDs from `models.json.providers`, enable or remove only that node, and leave `auth.json` and default-model settings alone. DeepSeek Harness uses an exclusive home-level `cordis.patch.yml` profile; its credentials remain in the local Host catalog and are synchronized through the native local Web credential API (ADR-0020), without baking managed keys into the persistent service environment. Native YAML with custom tags is retained verbatim by the advanced editor.
18: 
19: Edits use an atomic transaction journal with rollback on write or backend reload failure. A switch refuses active Codex/DSH work or approvals. Native Codex routing changes restart its owned backend and require sessions to be reopened. DSH awaits native Web configuration hot reload and updates native credentials without terminating the shared process; read-only environment overrides fail the switch and trigger rollback. Pi processes running independently must be reopened to load the changed provider list. The Host OAuth account store refreshes managed Codex accounts and preserves native CLI rotations by identity and timestamp.
20: 
21: The Android app sends only a saved provider ID, Agent kind and enable/disable choice over the paired E2E channel. It receives names, IDs, enabled state, and a non-secret global-default marker, never API keys, OAuth material, usage scripts, or raw native configuration. This is a deliberately bounded exception to the earlier no-credential-write rule in ADR-0002, requested for provider switching. Arbitrary config, npm package, CLI arguments and credentials from the phone remain excluded.
22: 
23: Codex additionally supports a Host-owned local routing mode modeled on CC Switch: Codex's native config temporarily points at an authenticated loopback Responses endpoint, which can pass through Responses or convert to Chat Completions/Anthropic Messages. The selected provider snapshot is immutable for each request; proxy-to-proxy switches affect later requests without restarting Codex. Optional failover uses only the explicit queue, with bounded timeouts, cancellation, circuit health, and no retry after streamed output begins. `/responses/compact` is passed to native Responses upstreams and converted requests use their normal endpoint. Official Codex OAuth accounts are not eligible for proxy failover. Disabling routing or shutting down restores the saved native configuration while preserving unrelated external preference/MCP edits, and routing conflicts are rejected for review. Provider routing credentials never flow to Android.

46: | 数据 | 所有者与性质 | 手机如何使用 |
47: | --- | --- | --- |
48: | canonical Entries | 从原生持久历史确定性生成；同 ID 的 parent/type/timestamp/data 不变 | 存入现有 SQLite；按当前 head 的 parent 链投影 |
49: | current state | 源端 adapter 持有：当前 head、当前 turn、live 消息、工具状态 | checkpoint 整体建立基线，patch 原子推进；不写成未完成 canonical Entry |
50: | local outbox | 手机尚未确认的发送操作，使用 command/operation 身份 | 单独显示发送状态；不能被“源端 live 为空”删除 |
51: 
52: `live` 包括正在生成的消息，以及**已经结束、但尚未稳定进入 canonical 历史的消息**。Pi 的 message_end 可能早于持久 append；Codex 后面的 item 可能已完成，但要等前面的 item 才能确定提交顺序。它们在正式提交前必须仍可被 sync 恢复。
53: 
54: 工具的 input/output、执行状态和所属 turn/message 同样是状态，不能只存在于事件里。终态工具在相关结果尚未 canonical 化时仍保留恢复信息。
55: 
56: 源端先更新这份状态，再发送变化。对 Pi，这个状态位于 Pi extension/runtime bridge；仅放在 Host 不够，因为 Pi 到 Host 断线时现有 transport 会丢弃事件。Codex/DSH 的 adapter 位于 Host 进程内，但与通用 Host 路由职责分开。
57: 
58: **实时与历史分区必须互斥且完整：已观察、应显示的内容，要么在 live 中，要么已提交到当前历史中，不能因“结束了但未落盘”消失，也不能以两个身份长期重复出现。**
59: 
60: ### 身份与提交
61: 
62: 首版采用两种身份：`(epoch, liveId)` 标识临时对象，`(sessionId, entryId)` 标识 canonical 节点。不要求新增永久 live→Entry 映射库。
63: 
64: 正常提交是一笔状态事务，例如：
65: 
66: ```text
67: baseSeq = 41, seq = 42
68: addEntries = [稳定的 Entry E]
69: removeLiveIds = [临时消息 L]
70: currentHead = E
71: ```
72: 
73: 源端先把 `addEntries`、`removeLiveIds` 和 `currentHead` 作为一个状态版本提交，再发布这个版本。手机收到后，在一个本地事务中校验并写入 Entry，同时切换 head、live 和复制游标；UI 不观察事务中间状态。手机写库失败不会改变源端 seq，重试 checkpoint 时已写入的同内容 Entry 幂等复用。
74: 
75: 丢失这笔事务时，checkpoint 会带来权威 head、完整 live 集合和所需历史引用：旧 L 不在 live 集合中就退出源端 live 层；E 通过 tail 或后续历史页取得。没有 E 的内容时显示加载缺口，不能保留 L 冒充最终消息。稳定跨阶段 messageKey 可改善动画和滚动连续性，但不是恢复正确性的前提。
76: 
77: 本地 outbox 不在上述替换范围内。若需要自动消除发送确认丢失造成的 pending 行，须能按已有 command/operation ID 查询可重取的提交结果。没有这一能力时保留“发送结果待确认”，不猜正文匹配、不自动重发；本方案不据此承诺用户命令恰好执行一次。

440: private fun PiMessageProjection.toChatMessage(messageId: String, failure: String? = null): ChatMessage? {
441:     if (role == "custom" && display == false) return null
442:     if (role !in setOf("user", "assistant", "toolResult", "tool", "custom", "bashExecution")) return null
443:     val blocks = if (role == "bashExecution") {
444:         val shellOutput = buildString {
445:             command?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank)?.let { append("$ ").append(it) }
446:             output?.takeIf(String::isNotBlank)?.let {
447:                 if (isNotEmpty()) append('\n')
448:                 append(it)
449:             }
450:         }
451:         listOf(RemoteContent(type = "text", text = shellOutput))
452:     } else when {
453:         content == null -> emptyList()
454:         content is kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive -> listOf(RemoteContent(type = "text", text = content.jsonPrimitive.contentOrNull.orEmpty()))
455:         content is kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonArray -> content.jsonArray.flatMap { raw ->
456:             val obj = raw as? JsonObject ?: return@flatMap emptyList()
457:             when (obj["type"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull) {
458:                 "text" -> listOf(RemoteContent(type = "text", text = obj["text"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()))
459:                 "thinking" -> listOf(RemoteContent(type = "thinking", text =
460:                     obj["thinking"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull ?: obj["text"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull.orEmpty()))
461:                 "toolCall", "tool_call" -> listOf(RemoteContent(
462:                     type = "tool_call",
463:                     toolCallId = obj["toolCallId"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
464:                         ?: obj["id"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull,
465:                     toolName = obj["toolName"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull
466:                         ?: obj["name"]?.jsonPrimitive?.contentOrNull,
467:                     arguments = obj["arguments"],
468:                 ))
469:                 else -> emptyList()
470:             }
471:         }
472:         else -> emptyList()
473:     }
474:     val failed = failure != null || isError == true || stopReason == "error" || stopReason == "aborted"
475:     // Older cached entries predate `remoteFailure`; fall back to the provider message so a failure
476:     // is never invisible, even if the text then differs from what the live stream showed.
477:     val failureLine = failure ?: errorMessage?.trim()?.takeIf { failed && it.isNotEmpty() }
478:     val content = if (failureLine != null && blocks.none { it.type == "text" && it.text == failureLine }) {
479:         blocks + RemoteContent(type = "text", text = failureLine)
480:     } else {
481:         blocks
482:     }
483:     return ChatMessage(
484:         messageId = messageId,
485:         role = when (role) {
486:             "user", "assistant" -> role
487:             "toolResult", "tool" -> "tool"
488:             "custom" -> "custom"
489:             "bashExecution" -> "system"
490:             else -> return null
491:         },
492:         content = content,
493:         timestamp = timestamp ?: 0,
494:         toolCallId = toolCallId,
495:         toolName = toolName,
496:         isError = failed,
497:     )
498: }
